How to Crab to Zero (GMTK 2026)

Download Now

A puzzle game about a little robot crab trying to save the world before its energy runs out.

Solve puzzles and complete levels using logic and your box-pushing skills.

No AI
All graphics, code, music, and sounds were created by Four Quarters team

WASD or Arrows : move controls 
Shift or Z : undo move
R : level restart
F2 : game restart
mouse wheel :  volume level

_____________________________________________________
FOR GMTK2026 VERSION ONLY
We had a happy little accident in level 4, the crates should say "78" and "93" instead of "62" and "26", but we missed it during the final crunch hours. Whoops!
_____________________________________________________
